name: runge2011_cranes
citation: Runge MC, Converse SJ, Lyons JE (2011) Which uncertainty? Using expert elicitation and expected value of information to design an adaptive program. Biological Conservation 144:1214-1223
licence: Work of United States Government employees (USGS and USFWS), 'Published by Elsevier Ltd.' with no copyright claim; the publisher's copy is paywalled
retrieved: 2026-11-23, copy of the published article posted by the Chesapeake Bay Program Scientific and Technical Advisory Committee (chesapeake.org/stac/presentations/285_Runge et al. 2011.pdf); Zenodo record 19669055 lists the article but its files are restricted
decision: Management strategy at Necedah National Wildlife Refuge to improve whooping crane reproduction, under eight hypotheses for nest failure
unit: weighted score over four objectives, each normalised to 0-1 (dimensionless; 1 is the best performance on all four); Table 2 is the fledging rate
weights_note: The printed weights sum to 100.1; they are normalised by their sum (exactly, as rationals).

table5.provenance: Table 5 (p. 1220): weighted response; rows = hypotheses, columns = strategies 1 to 7. Transcribed from the text layer of the PDF and checked against the printed 'Expected value' row.
table5.note: From the three-decimal entries the first column is 0.1067; the printed row was computed from unrounded predictions. All columns agree to 0.001.

table2.provenance: Table 2 (p. 1219): predicted fledging rate; same layout

targets.where: Section 4: 'the partial EVPIs do sum to the total EVPI'

evsi.provenance: Section 4 and Figure 3 (p. 1221): EVSI of observing the weighted score of one action with normal error of standard deviation sd, as a fraction of EVPI. Statements in the text; curve values read by eye from the figure to about 0.03.
statements: with sd of 0.03 or less the most informative action is kill flies and it generates more than 60% of the EVPI
with sd above 0.03 the most informative action is no salvage, followed closely by swap eggs
the EVSI of restore meadows is never high and drops off quickly
evsi.resolution: Our curves agree with Figure 3 to reading precision. In our calculation kill flies is the most informative action for sd up to about 0.028 and exceeds 60% of EVPI for sd up to about 0.023 (50.5% at 0.03), so the sentence '0.03 or less ... more than 60%' is a little generous at its upper end; the paper gives no table to settle it.
